I will apply about two quintals of DAP and urea from the cooperative, and also spread manure from my cattle because the land needs both. I will plant my own saved seed since improved varieties for this crop are hard to find in our area and too expensive anyway. Weeding will be done by my family over the season, but I will hire labor for about eight days during harvest when the work is heaviest.
